measures.name: Precip Latest
measures.expression: VAR v = IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", AVERAGEX(VALUES('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = CALCULATE(MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at])) RETURN CALCULATE(AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[precipitation]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t)), AVERAGEX(VALUES('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = CALCULATE(MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at])) RETURN CALCULATE(AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[precipitation_in]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t))) RETURN FORMAT(v, "#,0.00") & IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", " mm", " in.")

measures.name: Temp Latest
measures.expression: VAR v = IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", AVERAGEX(VALUES('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = CALCULATE(MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at])) RETURN CALCULATE(AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[temperature_2m]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t)), AVERAGEX(VALUES('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = CALCULATE(MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at])) RETURN CALCULATE(AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[temperature_2m_f]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t))) RETURN FORMAT(v, "#,0.0") & IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", " °C", " °F")

measures.name: Wind Latest
measures.expression: VAR v = IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", AVERAGEX(VALUES('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = CALCULATE(MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at])) RETURN CALCULATE(AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[wind_speed_10m]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t)), AVERAGEX(VALUES('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = CALCULATE(MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at])) RETURN CALCULATE(AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[wind_speed_10m_mph]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t))) RETURN FORMAT(v, "#,0.0") & IF(SELECTEDVALUE('Units'[unit], "Metric") = "Metric", " km/h", " mph")

measures.name: Cloud Color
measures.expression: VAR v = AVERAGEX(VALUES('RealTimeData'[location]), VAR t = CALCULATE(MAX('RealTimeData'[recorded_at])) RETURN CALCULATE(AVERAGE('RealTimeData'[cloud_cover]), 'RealTimeData'[recorded_at] = t)) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(v), "#cccccc", SWITCH(TRUE(), v <= 25, "#facc15", v <= 75, "#94a3b8", "#475569"))
